verified.name: Redwood Materials
verified.description: American battery-recycling company that recycles lithium-ion batteries to recover lithium, nickel, cobalt, and copper, and produces battery materials for electromobility and electrical storage systems.
verified.notes: Source [1] (Wikipedia) states valuation of about $6 billion as of October 2025. Current stage cannot be verified from sources—database entry lists 'Series D' but sources mention Series C ($775M) and Series E ($350M) without clarifying if these are the most recent or final stage. Total raised cannot be definitively determined from sources as they reference individual rounds ($775M Series C, $350M Series E) rather than cumulative total. Source [2] is about Greyparrot, not Redwood Materials, and was excluded.

changesProposed.name: SpaceX

verified.name: SpaceX
verified.description: American spaceflight, telecommunications, and artificial intelligence company headquartered in Starbase, Texas. Operates three divisions: Space (orbital launches), Connectivity (Starlink satellite communications), and Artificial Intelligence (Grok and data centers).
verified.notes: Wikipedia source indicates SpaceX completed its initial public offering on June 12, 2026, raising $86 billion, which was the largest IPO in history. Elon Musk owns 42% of outstanding shares and controls 85% of voting power (Wikipedia states 82% voting control in one location and 85% in another). Alphabet Inc. owns 6% equity stake.
